scripts.build: npm run validate && node scripts/build-site.mjs && node scripts/check-static-site.mjs dist
scripts.serve: npm run build && node scripts/serve-local.mjs dist
scripts.firebase:preview: npm run build && firebase hosting:channel:deploy revision --project nuvia-family-wealth --expires 7d
scripts.firebase:deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting --project nuvia-family-wealth
